verses.text: Listen to the word the LORD speaks to you, people of Israel!
This is what the LORD says: "Do not learn the ways of the nations, and do not be terrified by signs in the sky, even though the nations are terrified by them.
For the customs of these peoples are worthless. They cut down a tree in the forest, and a craftsman shapes it with his tools.
They decorate it with silver and gold. They fasten it with hammer and nails so that it will not fall over.

Their idols are like scarecrows in a cucumber field. They cannot speak. They must be carried, because they cannot walk. Do not be afraid of them. They can do no harm, and they cannot do any good either."
There is no one like you, LORD. You are great, and your name is mighty in power.
Who would not respect you, King of the nations? You deserve it. Among all the wise people of the nations and in all their kingdoms, there is no one like you.
They are all senseless and foolish. They are taught by worthless idols made of wood.
Beaten silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz. Craftsmen and goldsmiths make the idols. Then they dress them in blue and purple clothes, all made by skilled workers.
But the LORD is the true God. He is the living God and the everlasting King. When he is angry, the earth shakes. The nations cannot stand up to his fury.
"Tell them this: 'These gods, who did not make the heavens and the earth, will disappear from the earth and from under the heavens.'"
But God made the earth by his power. He set up the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding he stretched out the heavens.
When he speaks, the waters in the heavens roar. He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.
Everyone is senseless and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. His images are fake. They have no breath in them.
They are worthless, objects to be laughed at. When the time comes to judge them, they will be destroyed.
But the God of Jacob is not like these idols. He made everything, including Israel, the tribe that belongs to him. The LORD of Armies is his name.
Pick up your belongings and leave the land, you who are surrounded by the enemy.
For this is what the LORD says: "Look, this time I will throw out those who live in this land. I will bring trouble on them so that they will feel it."
How terrible for me because of my injury! My wound is very serious. But I said to myself, "This is my sickness, and I must put up with it."
My tent is destroyed, and all its ropes are broken. My children have left me and are gone. There is no one left to set up my tent again or hang its curtains.
For the shepherds are senseless and do not ask the LORD for guidance. So they do not succeed, and all their flocks are scattered.
Listen! The news is coming, a great noise from the land of the north. It will make the towns of Judah a wasteland, a home for jackals.
LORD, I know that people's lives are not their own. No one is able to direct their own steps.
Correct me, LORD, but only with fairness, not in your anger, or you will crush me to nothing.
Pour out your anger on the nations that do not know you, on the peoples who do not call on your name. For they have eaten up Jacob. They have eaten him up completely and destroyed his homeland.
